title: Skill (v3)
description: Canonical skill envelope (SPEC-014 R-1). skills-hub builds one envelope per validated Markdown document during federated source sync and stores/serves it verbatim. skill_id is namespaced <source_id>/<slug> where the slug is derived from the file path inside the source (not from frontmatter), so moves within a repo are visible as id changes. body travels in full-record responses (GET by id, store records); list and search responses omit or excerpt it. source_url carries upstream attribution for adapted open-source content. v2 (SPEC-055 R-3) adds an optional executable-flow class - a kind discriminator and a machine-readable steps replay list - and decouples risk_class from web_target so a write-class executable flow need not declare a browser target; knowledge skills omit both new keys and validate exactly as v1. v3 (SPEC-057 R-1) adds an optional composition class - kind=composition plus an ordered sub_skills reference list - that carries no authority of its own (ADR-0011): each referenced single-target sub-skill keeps its own HITL gate, and the composite's risk_class is derived for display only. A composition declares no web_target, no steps, and no author risk_class; a v2 consumer that ignores kind and sub_skills still ingests the body as grounded guidance, so v3 is additive.

skill_id.description: Globally unique id: <source_id>/<slug>; slug segments are lowercase [a-z0-9-] derived from the file path.

source_id.description: Operator-assigned source name from the SKILLS_SOURCES entry the document was ingested from.

source_path.description: File path of the document within its source repository.

source_ref.description: Synced Git ref or commit for git sources; a local marker (e.g. 'local') for directory sources.

description.description: One-paragraph summary used for search excerpts and citations (required frontmatter key).

tags.description: Bounded keyword list for filtering and retrieval (optional frontmatter key).

source_url.description: Upstream attribution link for adapted open-source content (optional frontmatter key).

web_target.description: Web-check flow entry URL: an absolute http(s) URL declaring this skill a browser-driven check flow (SPEC-049 R-3, optional frontmatter key).

risk_class.description: Declared effect of the flow's interactive steps (SPEC-049 R-3, optional frontmatter key). For a web-check flow it defaults to read when web_target is present without it. SPEC-055 R-3 decouples it from web_target: a kind=executable_flow skill declares risk_class=write for a mutating replay without a web_target, so the former 'requires web_target' rule no longer holds. For a kind=composition skill (SPEC-057 R-1) it is never author-declared: it is derived for display only (write when any resolved sub-skill is write, else read), persisted server-side at sync, and read by nothing in the deviation guard, identity guard, or policy engine.

flow_intent.description: Author-written plain sentence describing what the flow's gated mutating step achieves, shown as the lead decision line on the browser confirmation card (SPEC-053 R-1, optional frontmatter key; requires web_target; display-only, never a security input).

kind.description: Skill class discriminator (SPEC-055 R-3, optional frontmatter key; absent = knowledge). A knowledge skill grounds answers and never executes; an executable_flow skill carries a machine-readable steps replay list and, when any step mutates, must declare risk_class=write; a composition skill (SPEC-057 R-1) carries an ordered sub_skills reference list and no authority of its own - it declares no web_target, no steps, and no author risk_class (its risk_class is derived for display only). Additive: a knowledge skill omits it and validates exactly as v1.

tool.description: Canonical dotted gateway tool name the step invokes (e.g. web.navigate, web.fill_credential).

args.description: Step arguments. Credential values are credential-set references, never literals (SPEC-055 R-3/R-5); replay resolves them via web.fill_credential.

expect.description: Optional post-condition the step asserts before the flow proceeds (SPEC-055 R-3; a display/replay aid, never a security input).

steps.description: Ordered replay step list for a kind=executable_flow skill (SPEC-055 R-3, optional frontmatter key; present only for executable flows). Step-count and origin/risk_class bounds are enforced at runtime by graduation blast-radius re-validation and the gateway deviation guard, not by this contract.

skill_id.description: Namespaced id of the referenced single-target sub-skill (same <source_id>/<slug> pattern as the top-level skill_id). Must resolve to a published knowledge or executable_flow skill - never another composition (no nesting in Phase 1).

note.description: Optional author-written plain sentence describing this segment of the runbook (SPEC-057 R-1). Display-only and never a security input - the same standing flow_intent (SPEC-053) and steps[].expect (SPEC-055) have. It is a string, never interpreted, so no control flow can be smuggled in through it.

sub_skills.description: Ordered reference list for a kind=composition skill (SPEC-057 R-1, optional frontmatter key; present only for compositions). Order in the array IS the runbook's declared sequence, delivered to the model as grounded guidance - the platform enforces nothing about the order, provides no interpreter, and grants no authority (ADR-0011): each sub-skill keeps its own HITL gate. The item is additionalProperties:false by design (SPEC-057 R-3): there is deliberately no branch/loop/conditional/retry/early-exit key, because an interpreter would need loops and a loop defeats GATEWAY_BROWSER_FLOW_MAX_STEPS - currently the only bound on an unlocked browser flow. The count is bounded at ingestion by SKILLS_COMPOSITION_MAX_SUB_SKILLS (default 8), not by this contract.

updated_at.description: Ingestion-side UTC timestamp (RFC 3339) of the last sync that accepted this document.

body.description: Markdown body (frontmatter stripped). Present in full-record responses only; capped at 64 KiB.
